devices.state.connected.note: State word of a device on the Devices map.

devices.state.connecting.note: State word of a device on the Devices map.

devices.state.offline.note: State word of a linked device that cannot be reached now.

devices.node.this_mac_label.note: Screen reader name of this Mac's node.

devices.node.label_empty.note: Screen reader label of a device on the map without Imps.

devices.node.label.note: Screen reader label of a device on the map: its state and the Imps in it.

devices.map.summary.note: Screen reader summary of the Devices map.
devices.map.summary.en: Map of your devices: {devices} linked, {ours} Imps of this Mac, {visitors} Imps of other devices.
devices.map.summary.es: Mapa de tus dispositivos: {devices} vinculados, {ours} Imps de este Mac, {visitors} Imps de otros dispositivos.
devices.map.summary.zh-Hans: 设备地图：已链接 {devices} 台设备，这台 Mac 的 Imp {ours} 个，其他设备的 Imp {visitors} 个。

devices.route.local_at.note: How a channel goes: the local network, and the address.

devices.route.local.note: How a channel goes: the local network.

devices.route.hop_at.note: How a channel goes: through the Hop, and its address.

devices.route.hop.note: How a channel goes: through the Hop.

devices.route.tag_local.note: Small label on a line of the map that goes over the local network.

devices.unknown_device.note: A device this Mac is not linked with.
devices.unknown_device.en: a device not linked with this Mac
devices.unknown_device.es: un dispositivo no vinculado con este Mac
devices.unknown_device.zh-Hans: 未与这台 Mac 链接的设备

devices.this_mac_badge.note: Badge on the node of this Mac on the Devices map.

devices.edge.label.note: Screen reader label of a line between two devices.

devices.tether.label.note: Screen reader label of the line from an Imp to the device it thinks on.
devices.tether.label.zh-Hans: {imp} 在 {node} 上，在 {home} 上思考

devices.chip.label_ours.note: Screen reader label of one of this Mac's Imps on the map.
devices.chip.label_ours.en: {name}, an Imp of this Mac, on {node}
devices.chip.label_ours.es: {name}, un Imp de este Mac, en {node}
devices.chip.label_ours.zh-Hans: {name}，这台 Mac 的 Imp，在 {node} 上

devices.chip.label_visitor.note: Screen reader label of another device's Imp on the map.
devices.chip.label_visitor.en: {name}, an Imp from another device, on {node}
devices.chip.label_visitor.es: {name}, un Imp de otro dispositivo, en {node}
devices.chip.label_visitor.zh-Hans: {name}，来自其他设备的 Imp，在 {node} 上

devices.inspector.reach.note: Inspector card: how a device is reached.

devices.inspector.holds.note: Inspector card: this Mac's Imps a device holds.
devices.inspector.holds.en: Imps of this Mac it holds
devices.inspector.holds.es: Imps de este Mac que tiene
devices.inspector.holds.zh-Hans: 它持有的这台 Mac 的 Imp

devices.inspector.through_hop.note: Inspector card of the Hop: devices reached through it.

devices.reach.none.note: This Mac cannot be reached by other devices now.

devices.reach.last_seen.note: Label of the last known address of a device.

devices.call_all_home.note: Button: call every Imp a device holds home.

devices.tools.title.note: Inspector card: the tools Imps may use for a device.
devices.tools.title.en: Tools Imps may use from this device
devices.tools.title.es: Herramientas que los Imps pueden usar desde este dispositivo
devices.tools.title.zh-Hans: Imp 可为此设备使用的工具

devices.tools.info.note: Help of the per-device tool limits.
devices.tools.info.en: When this device asks one of your Imps, the Imp can use the tools that are on here. Switch off what it should not touch for this device.
devices.tools.info.es: Cuando este dispositivo le pide algo a uno de tus Imps, el Imp puede usar las herramientas activadas aquí. Desactiva lo que no debe tocar para este dispositivo.
devices.tools.info.zh-Hans: 当此设备向你的某个 Imp 提问时，Imp 可以使用这里开启的工具。关掉不希望它为此设备使用的工具。

devices.tools.not_mine.note: Shown when a device is not Mine.
devices.tools.not_mine.en: Imps answer this device without tools. Turn on Mine to choose what they may use.
devices.tools.not_mine.es: Los Imps responden a este dispositivo sin herramientas. Activa Mío para elegir lo que pueden usar.
devices.tools.not_mine.zh-Hans: Imp 回答此设备时不使用工具。打开“我的”后可选择它们能用什么。

devices.tools.commands.note: Name of the tool that runs commands.

devices.imp.talks.note: Inspector card: the Imps an Imp can message.

devices.imp.talks.info.note: Help: who an Imp can message. Selecting an Imp on the map lights them.
devices.imp.talks.info.en: The Imps this one can message. They are lit on the map while it is selected.
devices.imp.talks.info.es: Los Imps a los que este puede escribir. Se iluminan en el mapa mientras está seleccionado.
devices.imp.talks.info.zh-Hans: 这个 Imp 可以给哪些 Imp 发消息。选中它时，它们会在地图上高亮。

devices.visitor.send_home.note: Button: send a visiting Imp home.

devices.channel.title.note: Title of a line between two devices.

devices.tether.tools.note: Inspector card: the tools an Imp may use on the device it is on.

devices.tether.tools.info.note: Help: the tools are the device's limits.
devices.tether.tools.info.en: What the Imp may use while this device asks it. Change it on the device.
devices.tether.tools.info.es: Lo que el Imp puede usar cuando este dispositivo le pide algo. Se cambia en el dispositivo.
devices.tether.tools.info.zh-Hans: 此设备向 Imp 提问时，Imp 可使用的工具。请在该设备上修改。

home.corner.devices.away.note: Screen reader value of the Devices corner button when a linked device cannot be reached. A warning mark shows on the button.
home.corner.devices.away.zh-Hans: 有已链接的设备不在线

devices.hop.pill.note: The Hop pill under the code in the Link sheet when a Hop is set. {host} is its address.

devices.hop.add.note: The Hop pill under the code in the Link sheet when no Hop is set; opens its settings.

devices.place.body.note: Where an Imp's body is, as a tag on a device row.

devices.place.mind.note: Where an Imp thinks, as a tag on a device row.

devices.tools.toggle.note: Tooltip of the button that opens or closes a list of tool switches.

devices.tools.locked.note: Row in a device's sheet when the device is not Mine, so it gets no tools.
devices.tools.locked.zh-Hans: 设为“我的”之前没有工具

devices.reach.yes.note: Status of this Mac when other devices can reach it.

devices.hop.state.off.note: The Hop's state when none is set.

devices.hop.state.needs_address.note: The Hop's state when what is set is not an address yet.

devices.hop.state.idle.note: The Hop's state when an address is set and nothing goes through it.
